claims.text: Improvements to neural network language models (NNLM) can include using gate recurrent units (GRU), dropout strategies, and character-level models.
Implementing bidirectional recurrent neural networks (BiRNN) and importance sampling can enhance NNLM performance.
Increasing the model size and using specialized functions like encoding in changeless neural networks can improve NNLM performance significantly.
Understanding the limits of NNLM is crucial for defining improvement directions in various NLP tasks.
